title: Radiation biology on the ANTARES external micro-beam irradiation facility at ANSTO
task: Establishing ion microbeam capability for radiobiology research and demonstrating DNA damage induction in cells
key_results: Successfully induced DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs) in human fibroblast cells using MeV-energetic proton microbeam; demonstrated γH2AX foci formation indicating DSB detection; established first in-air ion microbeam irradiation facility in Australia with precision targeting capability
comments: This is primarily an instrumental/methodological paper demonstrating facility commissioning rather than fundamental biophysics discovery; the radiobiology outcomes are proof-of-concept validation rather than mechanistic investigation.

model_io.model: Human fibroblast cells on 75 nm silicon nitride membrane
inputs: MeV-energetic ion beam (H, C, O, heavier ions)

outputs: Predicted ion ranges in water (up to 2 mm)

hypotheses.hypothesis: MeV-energetic proton microbeam can induce detectable DNA double-strand breaks in live cells cultured on silicon nitride membrane
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via γH2AX immunocytochemistry signal in irradiated fibroblasts

title: PKM2 AP: a micropeptide inhibits vascular calcification via molecular glue-mediated ubiquitination of PKM2
task: Characterize micropeptide PKM2 AP as molecular glue promoting PKM2 degradation to suppress vascular calcification
key_results: PKM2 AP (40 amino acids) recruits STUB1 E3 ubiquitin ligase to PKM2, promoting its degradation and reducing aerobic glycolysis and lactate production; in vivo PKM2 AP administration and ORF2 knock-in alleviated vascular calcification in mice
comments: Novel micropeptide-as-molecular-glue mechanism is elegant and functionally validated in vivo, though tissue-specific bioavailability and therapeutic dosing remain uncharacterized.

hypotheses.hypothesis: PKM2 AP functions as molecular glue to facilitate STUB1-mediated PKM2 ubiquitination and degradation, suppressing glycolysis-driven osteogenic transition and vascular calcification
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PKM2 AP promoted PKM2 degradation, reduced lactate production, and alleviated vascular calcification in vivo

key_results: scMLEAge Bayesian approach achieved higher predictive accuracy than standard regression methods for estimating individual cell age from transcriptomics

inputs: Single-cell transcriptomic profiles from Tabula Muris Senis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bayesian statistical framework outperforms standard regression methods for single-cell age estimation

title: Comparative transcriptomic analysis reveals distinct ER stress responses in tunicamycin sensitive and resistant CHO cells
task: Distinguish transient ER stress responses from long-term adaptive mechanisms in TM-resistant CHO cells

comments: The pre-adapted transcriptional state model is compelling, though mechanistic drivers of this reprogramming remain incompletely characterized.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Long-term TM exposure drives transcriptional reprogramming that pre-adapts cells to ER stress
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; TM-resistant cells exhibit constitutively elevated stress regulators and lack acute UPR upon challenge

title: Combination of crocin and vitamin E mitigates UV-induced ROS and apoptosis in human skin fibroblasts
task: Evaluate cytoprotective synergy of combined crocin and vitamin E against UV-induced ROS and apoptosis
key_results: Combined crocin and vitamin E reduced intracellular and extracellular ROS and apoptosis with synergistic efficacy superior to individual compounds
comments: Synergy suggests complementary mechanisms (lipid vs. water-soluble antioxidants), but lack of in vivo validation limits clinical translatability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combined antioxidant treatment attenuates ROS-mediated mitochondrial dysfunction and apoptotic signaling

title: Targeting mitochondrial dysfunction and apoptosis in 5-fluorouracil–induced cardiotoxicity using kaempferol-mediated selenium nanoparticles

comments: Multifaceted cardioprotective effects are well-documented across biochemical, molecular, and histological parameters, though translation requires pharmacokinetic characterization and dose optimization.

key_results: FSSC adoption associated with reduced overall financial flexibility; cash flexibility reduction more pronounced than debt flexibility; strongest declines 1-2 years post-adoption; lower cash-flow sensitivity to investment

key_results: Testable prediction: latent-space signatures from different jailbreak attacks show general drift plus pathway-specific residuals; refutation conditions stated

title: Robust biexciton preparation for entangled photon-pair generation by single-shot Floquet driving

comments: Novel Floquet-engineering approach is elegant and shows promising fidelities, though demonstration on a single quantum emitter system limits scope; scalability to many-emitter arrays remains to be shown.

title: H2S-induced surface reconstruction enables efficient CsPbI3 QLEDs with ultralow roll-off

key_results: H₂S treatment creates robust Pb–S coordination environment; peak EQE 30.71% at 52 mA cm⁻², maintaining 18.59% EQE at ~500 mA cm⁻² and 21.15% at ~500 W Sr⁻¹ m⁻²; device operational half-lifetime 104,587 h

title: Controlling magnetic interactions in α-RuCl3 by strain
task: Control magnetic interactions in α-RuCl₃ via uniaxial strain to tune Kitaev exchange coupling
key_results: Tensile strain reduces principal gap excitation and enhances d⁴ triplet intensity relative to singlets; d⁴ triplet energy is sensitive to nearest-neighbor spin-spin correlations, indicating enhanced Kitaev interactions under tensile strain
comments: Optical spectroscopy provides indirect evidence for strain-tuned Kitaev interactions; direct spin-excitation spectroscopy or magnetometry would strengthen the claim of enhanced Kitaev coupling.

title: On the correlation between mechanical and electrical properties of pure and Ag doped ZnO nanoparticles
task: Correlate mechanical and electrical properties of Ag-doped ZnO nanoparticles across temperature range
key_results: Ag doping (up to x=0.04) increases elastic moduli, hardness, Debye temperature, and DC/AC conductivity while reducing activation energy (0.187–0.68 eV); conduction mechanism is correlated barrier hopping; relaxation peaks emerge at higher doping in tan δ and impedance spectra
comments: Comprehensive characterization linking mechanical stiffening to electrical transport via doping is valuable; the correlation mechanism (e.g., doping-induced defect reduction vs. carrier concentration) deserves deeper analysis.

model_io.model: Experimental characterization (XRD, FTIR, AFM, dielectric/impedance spectroscopy) across T=30–150 °C

title: Room-temperature mechanical and electronic transport properties in locally strained graphene devices during crack propagation
task: Characterize electronic transport and mechanical properties of graphene devices under local tensile strain during fracture

comments: Multiscale approach combining MD, tight-binding, and NEGF effectively captures strain-fracture-transport coupling, though room-temperature simulations may miss quantum effects in ultraclean samples.

hypotheses.result: Both factors reduce conductance, with synergistic effects observed near fracture

title: Spin–orbit coupling driven electronic phase transition and multifunctional response in lead-free K₂WCl₆ double perovskite for spintronic and energy applications
task: Investigate spin-orbit coupling driven electronic phase transition and multifunctional response in K₂WCl₆ double perovskite
key_results: SOC induces electronic phase transition from non-relativistic half-metallic to method-dependent magnetic-semiconducting (GGA+U+SOC, Eg≈1.572 eV) or metallic (TB-mBJ+SOC) states; high UV absorption, spin-dependent dielectric behavior, and thermoelectric figure of merit enhancement with temperature
comments: Rich phase competition and method-dependence highlight the theoretical challenge; experimental validation of the predicted multifunctionality and tunable electronic behavior is essential.

model_io.model: Density functional theory (GGA+U, TB-mBJ) + spin-orbit coupling

hypotheses.hypothesis: SOC strongly reconstructs W 5d electronic states near Fermi level, inducing electronic phase transition

title: Reconstruction of pretelescopic and early telescopic solar activity cycles from auroral records

title: Effect of cascaded centrifugal speed on scalability potential of few layer graphene via liquid phase exfoliation
task: Optimize liquid-phase exfoliation of graphite via cascaded centrifugation to produce high-yield, high-quality few-layer graphene nanosheets

title: A quantitative framework for ultrafast ptychography through digital twin control of extreme-ultraviolet beams
